data.one_liner: Powerful text syntax highlighting library translated from highlightjs.
data.what_it_does: Re-Highlight is a text syntax highlighting library that highlights code and text by defining syntax files. It has built-in rules for dozens of programming languages and converts highlight results to TextSpans.
use_when: You need syntax highlighting for code or text within a Flutter application.
You want built-in support for multiple programming language highlighting rules.
You are building a text editor or code viewing widget.
avoid_when: You need an alternative highlight package that is currently active and differs from highlight.dart forks.
strengths: Supports dozens of programming languages out of the box
Easy to convert results to TextSpan for Text widgets or TextEditingController
weaknesses: Relies on manual synchronization with the highlightjs project for new languages
